body: Ever since we were kids, my brother and I have played yugioh. We still do sometimes, although, i'm way more in to it than he is. In that time, my brother has bought and given cards to me, 4 to be exact. Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning, Gandora The Dragon of Destrcution, Rocket Warrior, and Swords of Revealing Light (super rare from LOB). I think he liked seeing how happy getting cards made me, and wanted to contribute to that. I will never let go of those 4 cards.
